research_hypothesis: A positive standardized earnings surprise followed by an unusually strong, high-volume, high-close-location first full trading session after an SEC filing produces a 63-session post-filing drift that is distinct from either the filing signal or the price reaction alone.

signal.sue_rule: event SUE must exceed the median of strictly earlier SUE observations in the same sector over the prior 365 calendar days
signal.signal_session: first complete trading session strictly after the conservative SEC fact availability date
signal.entry_session: next issuer trading-session open after the signal session
